_about: Hand-entered, SOURCED candidate positions. One entry per candidate; name and office must match how they appear in the ballot data. Each stance: v from -2 (strongly disagrees with the issue statement in issues.json) to +2 (strongly agrees), src = where it came from, url = link to that page. Needs at least 3 issues with a left/right direction to show a score. Never enter a position you cannot cite.
